# HODINKEE

> > HODINKEE is the premier online magazine for luxury watch enthusiasts, featuring in-depth reviews, hands-on coverage of major watch fairs, and expert analysis of timepieces from brands like Rolex, Patek Philippe, and independent watchmakers.

Founded by Benjamin Clymer, HODINKEE provides comprehensive coverage of horology including week-long watch reviews, breaking news from Basel World and SIHH, vintage watch collecting guides, and deep dives into watchmaking complications and craftsmanship.

## Key Topics

- Basel World coverage and new releases
- Week on the Wrist in-depth reviews
- Rolex and Patek Philippe flagship models
- Independent watchmaking (F.P. Journe, Kurono Tokyo)
- Chronograph complications
- Tourbillon mechanisms
- In-house movements
- Limited edition timepieces
- Vintage watch collecting
- Hands-on watch reviews
- TAG Heuer and Zenith
- Luxury sports watches
- Watch fair announcements
- Horological innovation

## Week on the Wrist Reviews

- [A Week On The Wrist: The Tudor Heritage Chrono Blue](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/a-week-on-the-wrist-the-tudor-heritage-chrono-blue): Tudor Heritage Chrono Blue week-long review from Basel World 2013
- [A Week On The Wrist: The Linde Werdelin SpidoLite II Tech](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/a-week-on-the-wrist-the-linde-werdelin-spidolite-ii-tech): Week-long review of Linde Werdelin SpidoLite II Tech sport watch
- [A Week On The Wrist: The Hamilton Pan-Europ Auto](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/a-week-on-the-wrist-hamilton-pan-europ-auto): Hamilton Pan-Europ Auto review: 1971 cushion-case chronograph reissue

## Basel World and Major Releases

- [Your First Look At The New Rolex Daytona And GMT-Master II](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/rolex-basel-2013-first-look): Baselworld 2013: 50th anniversary platinum Daytona & blue/black GMT-Master II
- [Hands-On: With The F.P. Journe Historical Anniversary Tourbillon](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/hands-on-with-the-fp-journe-historical-anniversary-tourbillon-and-the-pocket-watch-that-inspired-it): F.P. Journe 30th anniversary tourbillon inspired by original pocket watch
- [The Road to Basel Episode 3: In-Depth With The Jaeger-LeCoultre Gyrotourbillon Three](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/the-road-to-basel-episode-3-in-depth-with-the-jaeger-lecoultre-gyrotourbillon-three): Vallée de Joux manufacture visit exploring Gyrotourbillon Three chronograph
- [Introducing: The Panerai Luminor Submersible 1950 Carbotech](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/introducing-the-panerai-luminor-submersible-1950-carbotech): Panerai Submersible 1950 debuts with carbon fiber Carbotech case material
- [Zenith's New Lacquer Dial El Primero](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/zeniths-new-enamel-dial-el-primero-was-a-pleasant-surprise-at-sihh-2015): SIHH 2015: Zenith El Primero with lacquer dial and in-house movement

- [Hands-On: With The Antoine Martin Slow Runner](https://www.hodinkee.com/articles/hands-on-with-the-antoine-martin-slow-runner-live-pics-video-pricing): Basel World: Martin Braun's Antoine Martin Slow Runner with 1Hz movement
